text:
tara: onboarding a Dedicated customer hitting TLS verify errors when requests go through their corporate proxy + custom CA. AsyncClient sample works locally but pods fail with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED.

liam: are you setting SSL_CERT_FILE or REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE in the pod? are you passing base_url or using REDWOOD_BASE_URL?

tara: passing base_url directly. we tried SSL_CERT_FILE pointing at the mounted PEM and HTTPS_PROXY set but still failing. minimal snippet: 
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
async def main():
  c = AsyncClient(base_url='https://dedicated.example.com', api_key='***')
  await c.generate('ping')
```
no explicit ssl passed.

priya: aiohttp doesn't always pick up SSL_CERT_FILE on all platforms. quick workaround is creating an ssl.SSLContext with the CA and passing it down to the connector. we expose connector_args in the SDK but it's not obvious or well typed. e.g.:
```python
import ssl
ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile='/etc/ssl/custom-ca.pem')
client = AsyncClient(..., connector_args={'ssl': ssl_ctx, 'force_http1': True})
```
This fixed a similar customer case.

tara: that did work in my cluster, thanks. two followups from the customer: 1) they expect the env var flow (SSL_CERT_FILE + HTTPS_PROXY) to "just work" for async usage 2) our sample image/Dockerfile doesn't show how to add CA to OS truststore which they needed for some base images.

liam: also noticed a separate bug: the token refresh code created its own session and didn't inherit connector_args/ssl, so refresh requests went through proxy without the custom truststore which caused 401s then a retry loop. saw logs with repeating "token refresh failed" lines.

priya: actionable DX items: add a typed truststore_path param on AsyncClient, have the async client fallback to SSL_CERT_FILE/SSL_CERT_DIR when connector_args['ssl'] is absent, document Debian/Alpine steps and k8s initContainer to update truststore, and ensure refresh logic reuses the same connector/ssl context. also make connector_args typing mypy-friendly (Optional[Mapping[str, Any]]).

liam: i'll file a GH issue and attach a scrubbed repro + logs.

tara: scrubbed log: 
```
2026-03-19T09:12:01Z tara kube-proxy: CONNECT dedicated.example.com:443 failed: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed (_ssl.c:997)
2026-03-19T09:12:02Z tara auth: token refresh failed 401 via proxy
```

devx-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/5012 1title: "py-sdk: truststore_path param + async fallback to SSL_CERT_FILE; reuse ssl context for refresh retries" (assignee: liam).

priya: i'll PR a small helper that constructs ssl.SSLContext from SSL_CERT_FILE for aiohttp path and add an examples/onprem/k8s-init.yaml. tara: glad you have a working workaround, we'll iterate on DX. :+1:
